source_metadata.identity_policy: Literal original GEO donor titles identify four healthy controls and four author-labelled patients, each with one separately deposited PBMC RNA library. source_metadata.clinical_policy: Basal cryopreserved human PBMCs as stated in GEO. Preserve the two source cohort labels. Individual age, sex, treatment, collection date, family aliases and current clinical disease activity are unassigned; do not substitute broader publication demographics.
source_metadata.reuse_policy: Only eight original PBMC count triplets acquired. No reused integrated atlas, cultured-cell experiments, clinical functional assays or non-PBMC expression data added. Global donor and family aliases unresolved.
source_metadata.gene_policy: All64591original source feature coordinates audited unchanged. Human geometry retains all33538explicit GRCh38features in original order;31053explicit mm10features are excluded and separately documented. Source IDs/symbols preserved; exact GRCh38_ prefix removed only in the derived human symbol column. No feature selection, symbol modernization, intersection, inferred IDs or zero filling.
source_metadata.count_semantics: Original CellRanger3.1.0 gene-cell counts. All mixed-reference stored values audited as finite nonnegative integers. Human-only counts are used for expression, mitochondrial QC and TP10K denominators; no inverse normalization or rounding.
source_metadata.species_selection_policy: Select cells with human-reference RNA / all-reference RNA >=0.9, then require the common human-RNA QC thresholds. This is a conservative computational ambiguity filter, not a claim of biological species origin or contamination. Record all excluded-reference counts and preserve every source cell in output metadata.
source_metadata.source_limitations: Source donor proxies only; clinical/family/global aliases unresolved. The mm10reference axis is excluded without interpreting cell origin. No biological annotation or constellation validation claimed.
